Sandbox_CoolerFridge_CoolFactor_tooltip: Rot rate for food in an iced cooler, as a fraction of normal. 0.25 means food keeps four times as long. 0 stops rot entirely.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_IceLifeHours_toolti: In-game hours one full bag of ice lasts inside a cooler at 20 C. Hot weather burns through it faster, cold weather slower.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_IceLifeOutsideMult_: Multiplier applied to ice lifetime when the ice is not in a cooler. 0.2 means it melts five times faster in a backpack.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_FreezeHours_tooltip: In-game hours a powered freezer needs to turn water into ice, and to refill a melted bag of ice.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_WaterPerBag_tooltip: Units of water consumed per bag of ice produced.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_UseColdpacks_toolti: Lets the vanilla Cold Pack chill a cooler too, at 40% the strength of a bag of ice.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_SpawnIceInLoot_tool: Adds bags of ice to freezer loot. Turn off to make freezing your own water the only source.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_ShowColdTint_toolti: Chills the items in an iced cooler so the inventory window tints their rows blue, the same cue a powered fridge gives. Turn off to leave item temperature alone.
Sandbox_CoolerFridge_RenameCoolers_toolt: Adds (Iced) to the name of a cooler that currently holds ice.
